title: Animal harvesting and management
summary: This page provides information and links for various licenses and registrations related to managing and harvesting native animals, game, and other specimens in NSW.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a native animal keeper licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a native animal keeper licence using this link.

faqs.q: What are the options for managing native animals and birds?
faqs.a: You can apply for a licence to harm or pick a threatened species, or apply for a native game bird management licence.

faqs.q: Where can I find information about beekeeping?
faqs.a: You can apply for, renew, or update your beekeeper registration.

faqs.q: What licenses are needed for game harvesting?
faqs.a: You can apply for a NSW game hunting licence, and lodge harvest returns for both professional and public land.

faqs.q: Do I need a licence for taxidermy or possessing preserved specimens?
faqs.a: Yes, you must apply for or renew a licence to carry out taxidermy or possess preserved specimens.
